_about: Records of the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (https://trc.nist.gov/ThermoML/; open data, free to read even where the article is not) with binary vapour-liquid data of each pair, found by validation/python/scan_pairs.py. Set numbers and point counts as stored in each record; the values themselves are read from the record when a pair is fitted.
